integrity: The endpoint counterexample and its bad-ball estimates were checked in the primary full text. The closed-subspace strengthening is proved directly from disjoint translations and local separation; no numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for scalar-valued Euclidean Sobolev spaces at the endpoint alpha=1-n/p. It does not claim complementedness, a classification of the entire endpoint complement, or an extension to arbitrary metric-measure spaces or Banach-valued targets.
title: Endpoint modified compactly Hölder failure contains a closed \(\ell_p\) subspace
